case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Gruber,

Thank you for your offer and for the background on your costs. We value the long cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

Our own data shows a different picture:

Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

With that in mind, we would like to propose a longer partnership. The options below offer a longer contract term, which gives you planning security, and they differ in how quickly we pay, so you can choose what suits you best:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

To understand your calculation better, we would also appreciate your help with this:

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your proposal and the feedback regarding our delivery performance. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are open to a 24-month agreement with 45-day payment terms as outlined in your Option A, but we cannot accommodate the requested price reduction. We can offer a revised unit price of €4.90 for this package, and our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €4.90 per unit. As an alternative, we offer a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Gruber,

Thank you for your reply and for checking our delivery data. We appreciate your openness, and we understand that the price reduction is difficult for you. Our cooperation as two family companies matters to us, and we are looking for a fair solution for both sides.

We have therefore prepared three genuine options.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

We believe this is a serious, balanced step toward a lasting agreement, and we look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and your commitment to finding a fair solution. As your dedicated distributor, we are always keen to support your requirements with our extensive product range and reliable service.

In response to your movement, we can make a slight adjustment to our price for the 45-day payment term. Beside our current offer of a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, we can offer a unit price of €4.89 for a 24-month contract with 45 days net payment. For this alternative package, we can offer a unit price of €4.89 for a 24-month contract with 45 days net payment. 

Please note that our proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Gruber,

We value the years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

We have looked again at our figures and prepared the following options. Option A answers your wish for faster payment, and all three keep the longer contract term that gives you planning security.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

We see this as a serious effort to close, and we hope one of these options works for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised options and your continued effort to reach an agreement. As a dedicated distributor, we always value our partnership and are committed to supporting your business with our extensive range and reliable service.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We also propose a unit price of €4.91 for a 24-month contract with 60 days net payment. Furthermore, as an alternative option, we have a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure to serve you with our broad range and high-standard service, and we look forward to continuing our great cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
